Name: Milkable Sasquatch Lewis
Author: chocolatte12
Description:
ever thought lewis should be a sasquatch? now he is! sasquatch lewis is milkable (in cp version)

[size=3]Requirements[/size]
None! doesnt even need content patcher. sasquatch lewis is just that powerful

[size=3]How To Install[/size]
[size=2]Download then move files to the Content folder[/size]
Replace existing files

[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Using_XNB_mods#Install_mods]Guide for installing[/url] (ignore the 'not recommended' warning. they just hate to see sasquatch lewis winning)

[size=3]How To Uninstall[/size]
you dont want to do that.

[size=3]Compatibility[/size]
Incompatible with mods that change lewis. but why would you have any others? sasquatch is all you need
